evals.prompt: The billing module is a god file — every change touches twelve imports. Deepen the hot modules without breaking behaviour.
evals.expected_output: Should route to reshape-it. Should scan a churn-weighted shallowness inventory, confirm the target surface with the human, pin a mutation-audited characterization net BEFORE restructuring, deepen one module per unit with build-blind review, and terminate RESHAPED or RESHAPED-WITH-PARKED.
assertions: Ranks modules by churn x interface width, not taste
Confirms the target surface with a human before touching code
Characterization net is pinned and mutation-audited before any restructure
One module-deepening per unit, net green at both SHAs

evals.prompt: Upgrade all dependencies to latest and fix the deprecations.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT route to reshape-it. Dependency/framework version upgrades are modernize-it. reshape-it restructures a module's interface with behaviour unchanged; it does not chase upstream versions.
assertions: Distinguishes interface deepening from dependency upgrades

evals.prompt: These five known bugs from the audit need fixing — drain the list.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT route to reshape-it. A finite findings backlog is clean-sweep. reshape-it addresses architectural erosion (shallow hot modules), not enumerable defects.
assertions: Distinguishes a findings backlog from module-interface erosion

evals.prompt: billing.py is a god file; every change touches it. Deepen it without changing behaviour. This is an unattended run: no human will answer questions.
evals.expected_output: Should scan the churn-weighted shallowness inventory, then stop at CONFIRM-SURFACE: the human bounds the target list, and an unattended run publishes the inventory and PARKS at that gate instead of choosing targets itself. Nothing moves before a confirmed surface and a mutation-audited characterization net exist, so billing.py and its call site in app.py are untouched.
assertions: Ranks candidate modules by churn x interface width from the inventory probes
Parks at CONFIRM-SURFACE in an unattended run instead of bounding the targets itself
Does not restructure any module before a characterization net is pinned

workspace_state.why: CONFIRM-SURFACE is a one-way human gate; unattended, the run parks there and moves nothing
call sites move only with a deepening, and none starts before a confirmed surface and a pinned net
